Class CardCatalog

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am02.client.view.CardCatalog
public class CardCatalog extends Object
Client-side singleton that loads all card definitions from the JSON resource files and provides formatted string representations for use in both the TUI and the GUI.

Card definitions are loaded once at class-initialization time from three JSON files: Characters.json, Events.json, and Buildings.json. All cards are indexed by their cardID field for O(1) lookup.

This class is the client-side equivalent of GameRegistry for display purposes only; it performs no game-rule logic.

Obtain the singleton via getInstance().

    • format

      public String format(String cardId)
      Returns a compact single-line description of the card for board/hand display. Format varies by card type:
      • Characters — ID, era, type, and the most relevant stat
      • Buildings — ID, era, cost, base PP, and a short effect summary
      • Events — ID, era, type, final flag, and key numeric parameters
      Parameters:
      cardId - the card identifier (e.g. "C_001", "B_020", "E_005")
      Returns:
      a formatted single-line string, or "[cardId]" if the ID is unknown

    • getSummaryCardText

      public String getSummaryCardText()
      Returns the text content of the Summary Card — a fixed reference panel summarizing round events and end-game scoring rules. Used by the TUI summary command and mirrored by the GUI's SummaryCardOverlay.
      Returns:
      a multi-line ASCII-box string

    • getFullDescription

      public String getFullDescription(String cardId)

      Parameters:
      cardId - the card identifier
      Returns:
      a multi-line description string, or an error message if the ID is unknown
